summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.28/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.28 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 26, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 5¢ lower than a week ago, 45¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.50 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Madison ($4.11) and the highest in Superior ($4.41).
